poem.title: 鹿柴
poem.author: 王维
poem.text: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。返景入深林，复照青苔上。

user_prompt:
Translate this poem into literary English.
Title: 鹿柴
Author: 王维
Genre: 五言绝句
Source:
空山不见人，但闻人语响。返景入深林，复照青苔上。
translation:
**Deer Park**

No one is seen on the empty mountain;  
only the sound of voices is heard.  
Returning sunlight enters the deep forest  
and shines once more upon the green moss.
